failed_take.reading: The refund lands sixty minutes and ten seconds after the charge, which reads as a provider-side timeout rather than a fault in the request. 04-close-a was the other thirteen-second take and it came back fine, so the duration is not the cause. Nothing in the request differs from the seven that worked except the audio slice.
failed_take.not_resubmitted: BATCH-INTENT-V1.json says a take that fails is reported, not resubmitted, because a resubmission is new paid work. Resubmitting 01-open costs 91 credits again and is the owner's call.

rerun.request_identical: prompt bytes hash 8826029a, same as the first attempt; same references, duration and resolution
rerun.confirms: The first failure was provider-side. Nothing in the request was wrong.

generation.note: 595 for eight takes, which is what the original preflight said eight would cost. The failed attempt and its refund cancel out.

gate_hit_first.what: oe-cinema refused the first react-1 call because presenter/LOOK-LOCK.json did not exist in this experiment. The owner had picked P1 on 2026-10-09 but the pick lived only in LOOK-SELECTED.json, which the gate does not read.
gate_hit_first.resolved: oe-cinema lock-look wrote v1 from that pick; the locked still hashes 7b08bd3a..., the same bytes LOOK-SELECTED names.
gate_hit_first.worth_keeping: The gate was right. A paid presenter pass with no look lock in the canonical place is exactly what it exists to stop.

verified.duration: Every landed take returned exactly its span length. cut_off trims to the audio, so none needs trimming downstream and each drops straight into the frame count the Short already allots.
verified.framing: Contact sheets show P1's angle holding across the takes: phone-height selfie, face filling the frame, chambray, the inn breakfast room with the window right and the table edge low, no arm in frame, head steady on the lens.
verified.a_correction: I first reported 04-close-a at 531 frames. That was the AAC frame count: react-1 returns the audio stream first and the script was reading streams[0]. The picture is 271 frames at 24fps. The script now selects by codec_type and every count here is a picture count.

not_verified.lip_sync: Not asserted. The cross-correlation audit was inconclusive on the accepted take and the timing tooling has misread this material twice today. Owner viewing settles it, as it settled EP007.
not_verified.acceptance: None of these is accepted. Each is a separate stochastic result and gets its own view before it is mounted.

cost.react1_usd_estimate: about 1.3 to 2.1 per take at these lengths; fal does not report the charge in the result
